title: A War Within the War: Israel’s Bombardment of Lebanon

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在清晨4点半打电话给总统，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七个十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的彼端是什么。

sentences.zh: 一千份消费产品指南。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，持续陪伴您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受nytimes.com斜杠subscribe的特别优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的雷切尔·阿布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Breaking news, Israel saying it is now expanding operations in Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 突发新闻，以色列称其现在正在扩大在黎巴嫩的军事行动。

sentences.en: With the world's attention on the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran over the last two weeks, a second front has opened in Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 随着过去两周世界注意力集中在美以与伊朗的战争上，黎巴嫩开辟了第二条战线。

sentences.en: The target of those strikes, a Hezbollah stronghold.
sentences.zh: 这些空袭的目标是一个真主党据点。

sentences.en: The IDF says it's hitting sites linked to the group, which is backed and funded by Iran.
sentences.zh: 以色列国防军表示，他们正在打击与该组织有关的地点，该组织受到伊朗的支持和资助。

sentences.en: Israel has pummeled southern Lebanon and southern Beirut with airstrikes, displacing almost a million people.
sentences.zh: 以色列对黎巴嫩南部和贝鲁特南部进行了猛烈空袭，导致近百万人流离失所。

sentences.en: And it's expanded its assault into other parts of the capital.
sentences.zh: 并且它已将攻击范围扩大到首都的其他地区。

sentences.en: I carried the children quickly and we left towards the airport road.
sentences.zh: 我迅速抱着孩子们，朝机场路方向撤离。

sentences.en: People were like ants.
sentences.zh: 人们就像蚂蚁一样。

sentences.en: Like Judgment Day.
sentences.zh: 就像审判日一样。

sentences.en: It was like Judgment Day.
sentences.zh: 就像世界末日一样。

sentences.en: One man, his wife and four young children have fled a few miles north to safer ground.
sentences.zh: 一名男子、他的妻子和四个幼小的孩子向北逃了几英里，来到较为安全的地带。

sentences.en: Like many families, they'll spend the night on the streets watching the strikes at a distance.
sentences.zh: 和许多家庭一样，他们将在街头过夜，远距离观望空袭。

sentences.en: Today, Beirut Bureau Chief Christina Goldbaum explains how the crisis in Lebanon connects to the broader war, what Israel hopes to achieve,
sentences.zh: 今天，贝鲁特分社社长克里斯蒂娜·戈德鲍姆将解释黎巴嫩的危机如何与更广泛的战争相连，以色列希望实现什么目标，

sentences.en: and what the Lebanese people fear may come next.
sentences.zh: 以及黎巴嫩人民担心接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: It's Monday, March 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月16日，星期一。

sentences.en: Christina, since the war with Iran began, I think it's been clear that there has been sort of this second front emerging in Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜，自从与伊朗的战争开始以来，我认为很明显黎巴嫩已经出现了一种第二战线。

sentences.en: It started when Hezbollah, the Iranian-backed militia group that's based in Lebanon, lobbed missiles at Israel.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于总部设在黎巴嫩、受伊朗支持的民兵组织真主党向以色列发射导弹。

sentences.en: Israel lobbed missiles back.
sentences.zh: 以色列也向对方发射了导弹。

sentences.en: The two sides have traded fire for days now.
sentences.zh: 双方已经交火好几天了。

sentences.en: And that is not, in and of itself, an unfamiliar scenario, right?
sentences.zh: 就本身而言，这并不是一个陌生的场景，对吧？

sentences.en: But things have really escalated.
sentences.zh: 但局势真的升级了。

sentences.en: And you are based in Beirut.
sentences.zh: 而你的常驻地是贝鲁特。

sentences.en: You are the Beirut Bureau Chief for The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 你是《纽约时报》贝鲁特分社社长。

sentences.en: And so I'd like for you to paint a picture for our audience of what the last few days have looked like on the ground.
sentences.zh: 因此我想请你为我们的听众描绘一下，过去几天当地的地面情况是什么样的。

sentences.en: So what we've seen over the last two weeks is what feels like the beginnings of another major war in the country.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在过去两周看到的是，感觉像是这个国家又一场重大战争的开端。

sentences.en: Nowadays, when you're walking through Beirut, there is this acrid smell in the air from all of the airstrikes in and around the city.
sentences.zh: 如今，当你走过贝鲁特时，空气中弥漫着一股刺鼻的气味，来自城里及周边的各种空袭。

sentences.en: And you have the sound of Israeli drones overhead, this loud buzzing that's been a near constant over the last two weeks.
sentences.zh: 头顶上还能听到以色列无人机的声音，这种巨大的嗡嗡声在过去两周几乎没有间断过。

sentences.en: In certain parts of the city, life feels very normal, kind of untouched by the war, buildings intact.
sentences.zh: 在城市的某些地方，生活感觉非常正常，仿佛没有受到战争的触动，建筑物完好无损。

sentences.en: But in other parts of the city, walking around, you can see this mass displacement that has happened.
sentences.zh: 但在城市的其他地方走动，你能看到这种大规模流离失所的情况已经发生。

sentences.en: You see people putting up kind of makeshift tents out of tarps and out of gray blankets that people have set up in parking lots, on the seaside corniche, on sidewalks and in parks,
sentences.zh: 你会看到人们用防水布和人们在停车场、海滨大道、人行道和公园里搭建的灰色毯子搭起简易帐篷，

sentences.en: and living there because there isn't room in the schools that the government has turned into shelters.
sentences.zh: 并住在那里，因为政府改造成避难所的学校已经没有空间了。

sentences.en: In the Dakhia, in these southern suburbs where Hezbollah holds a lot of sway, a lot of buildings there have been just completely cratered in this bombardment by Israel.
sentences.zh: 在代希耶，也就是真主党势力强大的南部郊区，那里的许多建筑物在以色列的轰炸中被彻底炸成了弹坑。

sentences.en: And in the last couple of days, it felt like it escalated even more when Israel started targeting buildings and cars within central Beirut itself
sentences.zh: 而在过去几天里，随着以色列开始将目标对准贝鲁特市中心内的建筑和车辆，情况感觉进一步升级了，

sentences.en: and also issuing evacuation orders for buildings in central Beirut.
sentences.zh: 并且还对贝鲁特市中心的建筑物发出了疏散令。

sentences.en: You have guys who are, you know, shooting weapons up in the air to warn people to get out and massive crowds of people trying to get out of those buildings, get out of the street,
sentences.zh: 有些人在空中鸣枪以警告人们离开，大批人群试图逃离这些大楼、离开街道，

sentences.en: get out of the way before these strikes hit.
sentences.zh: 在这些空袭击中之前避开。

sentences.en: So there's very much now a sense, even in Beirut, that this conflict is escalating, that fewer and fewer places in the city that once felt safe are still safe.
sentences.zh: 因此，现在即使在贝鲁特，也有着强烈的感受，即这场冲突正在升级，城里曾经感到安全的地方越来越少。

sentences.en: And also just the scale of this is already huge.
sentences.zh: 而且这里的规模本身就已经非常巨大。

sentences.en: I mean, over a million people have been displaced so far.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，到目前为止已有超过一百万人流离失所。

sentences.en: That's in a country of 5.8 million people total.
sentences.zh: 这是在一个总人口为580万的国家里。

sentences.en: And you have more than 800 people who've been killed in Israeli strikes so far.
sentences.zh: 而且在以色列的空袭中已有超过800人丧生。

sentences.en: So now there is just this kind of tenseness here where people are really coming to terms
sentences.zh: 所以现在这里弥漫着一种紧张气氛，人们真正开始接受

sentences.en: with the fact that the country is yet again in less than two years being dragged into another major war.
sentences.zh: 一个事实：这个国家在不到两年的时间里再次被拖入另一场大战。

sentences.en: Christina, can you give us a sense of why this feels different than previous campaigns that Israel has waged in Lebanon, even as recently as 2024?
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜，你能让我们了解一下，为什么这感觉与以色列以往在黎巴嫩发动的军事行动不同，甚至包括2024年的行动？

sentences.en: I think what makes this different is the fears now that there is going to be a major Israeli ground invasion, which is something that the country has not seen since the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 我认为不同之处在于人们担心将会有一次重大的以色列地面入侵，这是该国自20世纪80年代以来未曾见过的。

sentences.en: There has been this massive buildup of troops on the Israeli side of the border.
sentences.zh: 在以色列一侧的边境上，集结了大量的部队。

sentences.en: And the rhetoric that we're hearing from Israeli officials is increasingly suggesting that they also view this war as something different.
sentences.zh: 我们从以色列官员那里听到的言论越来越表明，他们也将这场战争视为有所不同。

sentences.en: The Israeli defense minister compared the southern suburbs of Beirut to Han Yunus, saying that that's what it will soon look like.
sentences.zh: 以色列国防部长将贝鲁特南部郊区比作汗尤尼斯，称那里很快就会变成那个样子。

sentences.en: That's the city in Gaza that was completely destroyed.
sentences.zh: 那是加沙被完全摧毁的城市。

sentences.en: And he also said recently that if the Lebanese government cannot prevent Hezbollah from firing on Israel,
sentences.zh: 他最近还表示，如果黎巴嫩政府不能阻止真主党向以色列开火，

sentences.en: Israel, then Israel will take it upon itself to do so in Lebanese territory.
sentences.zh: 那么以色列将自行在黎巴嫩领土上采取行动。

sentences.en: And so that's obviously an escalation of rhetoric that has people here very on edge and feeling like this is going to be something bigger than what we saw the last time around.
sentences.zh: 因此，这显然是言辞上的升级，让这里的民众感到非常紧张，觉得这会比我们上次看到的规模更大。

sentences.en: I believe the defense minister, I think I saw comments from him saying that he wanted to basically flatten large swaths of southern Beirut.
sentences.zh: 我相信防长，我好像看到过他的言论，说他基本上想铲平贝鲁特南部的大片地区。

sentences.en: He was naming individual cities.
sentences.zh: 他甚至点名了具体的城市。

sentences.en: Yes, he said that about Dahia, this cluster of neighborhoods on the southern edge of the city.
sentences.zh: 是的，他对代希耶说了这番话，这是城市南缘的一群居民区。

sentences.en: The other thing we've seen that makes this feel like it's going to be much bigger is that for the first time, we didn't see this in 2024, but for the first time,
sentences.zh: 我们看到的另一件让人觉得这次规模会大得多的事情是，破天荒头一次——我们在2024年没有看到这一点，但这是第一次——

sentences.en: Israel has issued sweeping evacuation orders for all of the southern suburbs of Beirut,
sentences.zh: 以色列对贝鲁特南部郊区发布了全面的疏散令，

sentences.en: as well as a huge swath of territory in southern Lebanon that extends as far as 25 miles from the border.
sentences.zh: 以及黎巴嫩南部延伸至距离边境长达25英里的大片领土。

sentences.en: That's something that we did not see in the war in 2024.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在2024年战争中没有看到的情况。

sentences.en: Obviously, there's a war going on with Iran right now.
sentences.zh: 显然，目前正与伊朗爆发战争。

sentences.en: What is the relationship between this war in Lebanon and that wider conflict?
sentences.zh: 这场黎巴嫩战争与那场更广泛的冲突之间有什么关系？

sentences.en: So after the war in Iran began, Hezbollah then fired on Israel in retaliation, it said, for the killing of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei there.
sentences.zh: 所以，在对伊朗的战争开始后，真主党随后向以色列开火，据称是为了报复阿亚图拉·阿里·哈梅内伊在当地被杀。

sentences.en: Israel then struck back and started firing on Lebanon in the south and the east and in the southern parts of Beirut.
sentences.zh: 以色列随后进行反击，开始轰炸黎巴嫩南部、东部以及贝鲁特南部。

sentences.en: And what everyone understood was that Israel was kind of taking this attack by Hezbollah as an
sentences.zh: 而所有人都明白，以色列实际上是将真主党的这次袭击视为一个

sentences.en: opportunity to do what they have wanted to do for so long, which is, for once and for all, take out Hezbollah.
sentences.zh: 机会，来做他们长期以来一直想做的事情，那就是一劳永逸地消灭真主党。

sentences.en: And so what we're seeing right now is essentially kind of a war within a war, the second front that
sentences.zh: 因此，我们现在所看到的本质上是一场战争中的战争，即第二战线，

sentences.en: is actually a much bigger war for Lebanon and feels much more consequential for this country.
sentences.zh: 对黎巴嫩而言，这实际上是一场规模大得多、且对这个国家影响深远得多的战争。

sentences.en: So just to be clear, Hezbollah started this conflict in solidarity with Iran, and it has spiraled from there.
sentences.zh: 所以为了澄清，真主党是为了声援伊朗而挑起这场冲突的，然后局势就此恶化失控。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it's important to note that this kind of took a lot of people here by surprise.
sentences.zh: 需要指出的是，这让这里的许多人感到非常意外。

sentences.en: Very few people thought that Hezbollah would get involved in this conflict.
sentences.zh: 很少有人认为真主党会卷入这场冲突。

sentences.en: Obviously, Israel has been at odds and in conflict with Lebanon and Hezbollah for many, many years.
sentences.zh: 显然，以色列与黎巴嫩及真主党多年来一直处于对立和冲突状态。

sentences.en: Can you just give us a brief history of that back and forth?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们简单讲讲这种来回交锋的历史吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: So this dates back to the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 这可以追溯到20世纪80年代。

sentences.en: And to set the scene a little bit, you know, at that time, Lebanon is in the midst of the civil war.
sentences.zh: 为了稍微铺垫一下背景，你知道，当时黎巴嫩正处于内战之中。

sentences.en: You have Palestinian groups in southern Lebanon that are launching attacks on Israel.
sentences.zh: 黎巴嫩南部的巴勒斯坦组织正在对以色列发动袭击。

sentences.en: And then in 1982, Israel launches this large-scale invasion of southern Lebanon, getting as far as the capital, Beirut, and then occupying the south for, I mean, nearly 20 years.
sentences.zh: 然后在1982年，以色列对黎巴嫩南部发动了大规模入侵，一直打到首都贝鲁特，随后对南部进行了长达近20年的占领。

sentences.en: And it was within that context in the 1980s that Hezbollah came to be.
sentences.zh: 正是在20世纪80年代的这一背景下，真主党诞生了。

sentences.en: It emerged as this Shiite militant and political movement that was dedicated to what it described as resisting Israeli presence in Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 它作为一个什叶派武装和政治运动出现，致力于其所描述的抵抗以色列在黎巴嫩存在的行动。

sentences.en: And it had the backing of the vanguard of Shia Islam in the region, Iran.
sentences.zh: 并且它得到了该地区什叶派伊斯兰教先锋——伊朗的支持。

sentences.en: And so throughout that period of Israeli occupation in the south, Hezbollah militants were fighting with Israeli forces.
sentences.zh: 因此，在以色列对南部占领的整个时期，真主党武装人员一直与以色列军队作战。

sentences.en: And eventually, when Israel withdrew from southern Lebanon in 2000, it was seen as this major victory for Hezbollah.
sentences.zh: 最终，当以色列在2000年从黎巴嫩南部撤军时，这被视为真主党的一大胜利。

sentences.en: And with that, it started to expand its political influence while also keeping its armed wing.
sentences.zh: 随着这一事件，它开始扩大其政治影响力，同时保留了其武装翼侧。

sentences.en: So for years after that, you know, tension was still very high along the border between the two.
sentences.zh: 所以在之后的多年里，你知道，双方边境地区的紧张局势依然非常高。

sentences.en: There were periodic clashes.
sentences.zh: 期间发生了周期性的冲突。

sentences.en: But then in 2023, we saw this much larger escalation between the two.
sentences.zh: 但到了2023年，我们看到双方之间的冲突规模大幅升级。

sentences.en: So in October 2023, Hezbollah launched rockets at Israeli positions in solidarity with Hamas, another Iran-backed group.
sentences.zh: 因此在2023年10月，真主党为了声援另一个受伊朗支持的组织哈马斯，向以色列阵地发射了火箭弹。

sentences.en: Which had just attacked Israel in the October 7th attacks, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，该组织刚刚在10月7日的袭击中攻击了以色列。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that escalated into a major conflict.
sentences.zh: 这演变成了一场重大冲突。

sentences.en: I mean, Israel bombarded much of the south and eastern Lebanon, as well as Beirut.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，以色列轰炸了黎巴嫩南部和东部的大部分地区，以及贝鲁特。

sentences.en: It exploded thousands of pagers carried by Hezbollah members.
sentences.zh: 它引爆了真主党成员随身携带的数千个寻呼机。

sentences.en: And it killed Hassan Nasrallah, the longtime leader of Hezbollah, in what was a major blow to the group.
sentences.zh: 并且它炸死了真主党长期领导人哈桑·纳斯鲁拉，这对该组织是一个沉重的打击。

sentences.en: I think for the last year, a lot of people have had the impression that because of all of those events,
sentences.zh: 我认为在过去的一年里，许多人有一种印象，因为所有这些事件——

sentences.en: the killing of Nasrallah, the Pager incident, the attacks by Israel, that Hezbollah had been severely weakened, right?
sentences.zh: 纳斯鲁拉被杀、寻呼机事件、以色列的袭击——真主党已经被严重削弱了，对吧？

sentences.en: So if Hezbollah has been severely weakened, why would Israel need to go after them so hard right now, if presumably they pose less of a threat?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果真主党已经被严重削弱，既然他们构成的威胁可能较小，为什么以色列现在还要如此猛烈地打击他们？

sentences.en: I think what we're seeing right now is Israel really seizing on this moment where a lot of eyes are on the war in Iran.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们现在看到的是，以色列真正抓住了这个许多目光聚焦于对伊朗战争的时刻。

sentences.en: The country's feeling emboldened by its partnership with the United States, feeling its own military strength.
sentences.zh: 该国因与美国的伙伴关系而感到受到鼓舞，也感受到了自身的军事力量。

sentences.en: And it senses this kind of weakness and its two, you know, fiercest adversaries, because Hezbollah was always the strongest among Iran's proxies.
sentences.zh: 并且它在其两个，你知道的最凶猛的对手身上嗅到了这种虚弱，因为真主党一直是伊朗代理人中最强大的一支。

sentences.en: We also know from, you know, reporting out of our Jerusalem Bureau that this Israeli offensive in Lebanon has been months in the making.
sentences.zh: 我们还从我们耶路撒冷分社的报道中得知，以色列在黎巴嫩的这场攻势已经筹划了数月之久。

sentences.en: And Israel was essentially just waiting for the opportunity for Hezbollah to fire on Israel to attack in order to carry out these long-laid plans.
sentences.zh: 以色列基本上只是在等待真主党向以色列开火的机会，以便发起攻击来执行这些长期制定的计划。

sentences.en: And I think it's important to note that while the kind of going narrative over the last year was that Hezbollah has been battered,
sentences.zh: 我认为值得指出的是，虽然过去一年的普遍说法是真主党已经遭到重创，

sentences.en: what we're seeing now is proof that they're still able to mount a fight, even if they are severely weakened.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在看到的证据表明，即使他们被严重削弱，他们仍然有能力组织战斗。

sentences.en: We're seeing that they've been able to manufacture and locally assemble arms within Lebanon to replenish its weapons stockpile.
sentences.zh: 我们看到他们能够在黎巴嫩境内制造和本土组装武器，以补充其武器库存。

sentences.en: And even after, you know, their senior military ranks were wiped out during the war, what we've also seen now is how members of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps,
sentences.zh: 甚至在他们的最高军事指挥层在战争期间被消灭之后，我们现在也看到伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）的成员似乎进入该国，以补充这些职位并更好地控制真主党的军事武器。

sentences.en: the IRGC, appeared to come into the country to replenish those ranks and take even greater control of Hezbollah's military arMs.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至看到伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队——

sentences.en: And we've seen proof of that over the past two weeks.
sentences.zh: IRGC的成员似乎进入该国以补充这些阶层，并对真主党的军事武器拥有更大的控制权。

sentences.en: Already, at least two Israeli soldiers have been killed and more than a dozen injured.
sentences.zh: 过去两周我们已经看到了这方面的证据。已有至少两名以色列士兵丧生，十多人受伤。

sentences.en: So there is this sense now that even though over the last year,
sentences.zh: 所以现在有一种感觉，尽管在过去的一年里，

sentences.en: Hezbollah has not appeared to be very militarily strong, while it hasn't responded to the near-daily airstrikes by Israel that have happened despite the ceasefire,
sentences.zh: 真主党在军事上似乎并不十分强大，尽管它没有对以色列几乎每天都在进行的空袭做出回应（这些空袭在停火期间依然发生），

sentences.en: that in fact it was using the past year to in part rebuild and prepare for this major conflict that it too expected would happen with Israel.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，它一直在利用过去的一年部分进行重建，并为它同样预料到会发生的与以色列的这场大战做准备。

sentences.en: Given all of that, if Israel's goal is to finally take out Hezbollah's ability to operate and just maybe completely wipe them out once and for all,
sentences.zh: 鉴于这一切，如果以色列的目标是最终剥夺真主党的作战能力，甚至可能将其彻底一网打尽，

sentences.en: is that actually possible in this moment?
sentences.zh: 这在当前时刻真的可能实现吗？

sentences.en: So this has been a long-time project of Israel for decades now.
sentences.zh: 所以，这几十年来一直是以色列的一个长期项目。

sentences.en: And so far, Israel has not been able to disarm or eliminate the group.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，以色列一直未能解除该组织的武装或将其消灭。

sentences.en: But I think what we're seeing is Israeli officials seeing a moment to seize on when they could finally take out this group that has for decades posed a threat to Israel.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们看到的是，以色列官员看到一个可以抓住的时刻，他们终于可以消灭这个数十年来对以色列构成威胁的组织。

sentences.en: But all of the challenges that have existed over the last several decades when it comes to Israel's aim of disarming Hezbollah are still there.
sentences.zh: 然而，过去几十年里在解除真主党武装的目标上面临的所有挑战依然存在。

sentences.en: So this is still a very complicated endeavor.
sentences.zh: 因此，这仍然是一项非常复杂的任务。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温纳露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《纽约时报》游戏中的益智游戏“连线（Connections）”。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢试图套路你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天创作“拼字蜂（Spelling Bee）”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉（promesthesia）的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚刚听到的这些人一样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往nytimes.com斜杠games开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: So, Christina, you explained that Israel would face all of these challenges in its quest to take out Hezbollah.
sentences.zh: 所以，克里斯蒂娜，你解释过以色列在试图消灭真主党时将面临所有这些挑战。

sentences.en: But this time, the circumstances are different enough that at least Israeli officials seem to think that they might have more of a chance.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，情况发生了足够大的变化，至少以色列官员似乎认为他们可能会有更大的机会。

sentences.en: Can you just explain why they think that?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下为什么他们会这么认为吗？

sentences.en: So, I think first off, you have to keep in mind that, yes, Hezbollah is an Iran-backed militant group.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为首先，你必须记住，是的，真主党是一个受伊朗支持的民兵组织。

sentences.en: But it's also a very strong political and social movement that is embedded in Lebanese society here, especially among the Shia community, which is about a third of the country.
sentences.zh: 但它同时也是一个强大的政治和社会运动，扎根于这里的黎巴嫩社会，特别是在占该国人口约三分之一的什叶派社群中。

sentences.en: And for decades, it has essentially had the Lebanese government in a chokehold where no political decisions could be made without its support.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，真主党对黎巴嫩政府拥有实质上的绝对控制权，没有它的支持，任何政治决策都无法通过。

sentences.en: So, it is the most powerful political party in the country.
sentences.zh: 因此，它是这个国家最具权势的政党。

sentences.en: It holds seats in Lebanon's parliament.
sentences.zh: 它在黎巴嫩议会中拥有席位。

sentences.en: And it also runs this vast network of social services that its supporters benefit from, like schools and hospitals.
sentences.zh: 它还运营着一个庞大的社会服务网络，其支持者从中受益，例如学校和医院。

sentences.en: And it employs tens of thousands of people within that network.
sentences.zh: 该网络雇用了数万名员工。

sentences.en: So, it does hold this immense sway in Lebanese society.
sentences.zh: 因此，它在黎巴嫩社会中确实拥有巨大的影响力。

sentences.en: A lot of people have described it as being like a state within a state.
sentences.zh: 许多人将其描述为“国中之国”。

sentences.en: I visited Beirut a few years ago, and one thing that really stood out to me was all of the Hezbollah flags,
sentences.zh: 几年前我访问贝鲁特时，有一件事给我留下了深刻的印象，那就是到处都是真主党的旗帜、

sentences.en: Hezbollah shirts, Hezbollah merchandise that you could purchase, particularly in the south of Lebanon, where Hezbollah obviously has a huge presence.
sentences.zh: 真主党衬衫以及各种真主党周边商品，特别是在黎巴嫩南部，真主党显然在那里有着巨大的影响力。

sentences.en: And it really hit home this idea that Hezbollah, in a way that perhaps Americans or people outside of the country can't fully appreciate, it is this political party.
sentences.zh: 这真切地让我体会到，真主党作为一个政党，其影响力是以一种美国人或境外人士可能无法完全理解的方式存在的。

sentences.en: It is fully embedded in the population.
sentences.zh: 它完全融入了当地民众的生活。

sentences.en: I had a friend say to me that if his mother's car broke down, he hoped it would be in a Hezbollah neighborhood, because those are the folks that are more likely to help.
sentences.zh: 曾有一位朋友对我说，如果他母亲的车抛锚了，他希望是在真主党控制的街区，因为那里的人更有可能伸出援手。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But now we're also beginning to see that loyal base of support tested like it hasn't been before, and more tired than it's been before.
sentences.zh: 但现在我们也开始看到，这种坚定的支持基础正经历前所未有的考验，并感到了前所未有的疲惫。

sentences.en: A lot of people who have been displaced, the vast majority, are people who are in areas that are more sympathetic to Hezbollah.
sentences.zh: 许多流离失所的人，绝大多数都来自对真主党更有好感的地区。

sentences.en: So, it means that a lot of Hezbollah supporters are the ones that have been shouldering the burdens of these wars over the last two years.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，在过去的两年里，许多真主党支持者一直在独自承担这些战争带来的重压。

sentences.en: The one thing that they keep telling me is how exhausted they are.
sentences.zh: 他们不断向我重复的一点就是他们有多么筋疲力尽。

sentences.en: How after the last war in 2023, 2024, and then this one, they're tired of evacuating from their homes,
sentences.zh: 在经历了2023年、2024年的上一场战争，以及现在的这场战争之后，他们厌倦了从家中撤离，

sentences.en: they're tired of living in shelters, they're tired of their towns and villages, especially in the south, being flattened by airstrikes.
sentences.zh: 厌倦了住在避难所里，厌倦了他们的城镇和村庄（尤其是南部地区）在空袭中被夷为平地。

sentences.en: They're tired of rebuilding homes, only to now worry that they're going to get demolished again.
sentences.zh: 他们厌倦了重建家园，却又不得不担心家园再次被毁。

sentences.en: So, I think we're starting to see this very new feeling right now.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为我们现在开始看到这种全新的情绪。

sentences.en: For ages, there's been this kind of fervent ideological zeal within Hezbollah's support base to resist Israel at any coSt.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，真主党的支持者群体中一直有一种狂热的思想热情，要不惜一切代价抵抗以色列。

sentences.en: And Hezbollah still does command a lot of support and can turn out massive crowds, especially in Beirut.
sentences.zh: 而且真主党仍然拥有强大的支持，能够动员庞大的人群，尤其是在贝鲁特。

sentences.en: But right now, we're starting to see that commitment give way to this kind of wariness of war.
sentences.zh: 但现在，我们开始看到这种承诺让位给了一种对战争的厌战情绪。

sentences.en: And also, just some people that are questioning why Hezbollah chose to become involved in this war.
sentences.zh: 还有一些人开始质疑，为什么真主党会选择卷入这场战争。

sentences.en: Why they chose to fire on Israel only after the killing of a foreign leader, Ayatollah Khamenei, and not over the last year when Lebanese have been killed in Israeli airstrikes.
sentences.zh: 为什么他们选择在外国领导人阿亚图拉·哈梅内伊被杀后才向以色列开火，而不是在过去一年里黎巴嫩人在以色列空袭中丧生时开火。

sentences.en: It sounds like what people are telling you is that, increasingly, they are, maybe for the first time, questioning Hezbollah, questioning their support for Hezbollah.
sentences.zh: 听起来人们对你的讲述是，他们可能破天荒第一次开始质疑真主党，质疑他们对真主党的支持。

sentences.en: And that feels quite new.
sentences.zh: 这感觉相当新鲜。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: In one of the shelters that we went to...
sentences.zh: 在我们去过的一个避难所里……

sentences.en: Can you tell us her name and age?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们她的名字和年龄吗？

sentences.en: I actually ran into a nurse who I had met during the last war in 2024 in a hospital in the southern city of Nebatiyah.
sentences.zh: 我实际上遇到了一位护士，我曾在2024年上一场战争期间南部城市纳巴提耶的一家医院里见过她。

sentences.en: From Nebatiyah?
sentences.zh: 来自纳巴提耶？

sentences.en: And when did you leave Nebatiyah?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候离开纳巴提耶的？

sentences.en: And at that time, she was dealing with this influx of people who were injured in Israeli strikes.
sentences.zh: 当时，她正在应付大量在以色列空袭中受伤的涌入人群。

sentences.en: And now, with this war, she's been displaced from Nebatiyah to Beirut.
sentences.zh: 而现在，随着这场战争的爆发，她已经从纳巴提耶流离失所到了贝鲁特。

sentences.en: And my colleagues and I sat with her and her family, and we were talking about this very question.
sentences.zh: 我和同事们与她及她的家人坐在一起，我们正是在讨论这个核心问题。

sentences.en: What are the costs of these wars?
sentences.zh: 这些战争的代价是什么？

sentences.en: Are these wars worth it?
sentences.zh: 这些战争值得吗？

sentences.en: And they were debating among themselves whether Hezbollah remains their main defender.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在争论真主党是否依然是他们主要的保护者。

sentences.en: Because keep in mind, you know, as Israeli forces have moved into the south, the Lebanese army is pretty much nowhere to be found.
sentences.zh: 因为请记住，你知道的，随着以色列军队进入南部，黎巴嫩军队几乎不见踪影。

sentences.en: On the other hand, they're also wondering if actually, because Hezbollah has now dragged the country into war twice in two years, whether that is still the case.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，他们也在纳闷，由于真主党在两年内两次把这个国家拖入战争，这种情况是否还是这样。

sentences.en: Whether they are still able to defend the Shia community and whether the cost the Shia community is bearing is worth it.
sentences.zh: 他们是否仍然有能力保护什叶派社区，什叶派社区所承受的代价是否值得。

sentences.en: If the Lebanese government is so dysfunctional, what is their capacity to help their own people?
sentences.zh: 如果黎巴嫩政府如此无能，他们帮助自己人民的能力又在哪里？

sentences.en: And what is their relationship to Hezbollah?
sentences.zh: 他们与真主党的关系是什么？

sentences.en: What do they want from Hezbollah in this moment?
sentences.zh: 此时此刻他们想从真主党那里得到什么？

sentences.en: So this has been the main topic of political conversation in Lebanon over the last year.
sentences.zh: 因此，这成为过去一年中黎巴嫩政治对话的主题。

sentences.en: Because in that time, the country has kind of reached this political tipping point.
sentences.zh: 因为在那段时间里，这个国家可以说是达到了一个政治转折点。

sentences.en: After the ceasefire in 2024, there was this kind of sea change here, where the Lebanese government agreed for the first time ever to begin a process of disarming Hezbollah.
sentences.zh: 在2024年停火之后，这里发生了一种翻天覆地的变化，黎巴嫩政府历史上第一次同意开始解除真主党武装的进程。

sentences.en: Now, of course, over the past year, we've seen the many, many challenges that come with trying to do so.
sentences.zh: 当然，在过去的一年里，我们看到了试图这样做所带来的重重挑战。

sentences.en: The Lebanese military is weak.
sentences.zh: 黎巴嫩军队很弱小。

sentences.en: You know, its soldiers are underpaid.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它的士兵薪水过低。

sentences.en: It is not terribly well-equipped.
sentences.zh: 它的装备也算不上精良。

sentences.en: So in many ways, it is outmatched by Hezbollah.
sentences.zh: 所以在许多方面，它在真主党面前完全处于下风。

sentences.en: And at the same time, there is this fear that if the government moves too quickly and too decisively, it could lead to a clash between Lebanese soldiers and Hezbollah fighters.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，人们也担心，如果政府行动太快、太果断，可能会导致黎巴嫩士兵和真主党武装人员之间爆发冲突。

sentences.en: And that here is a recipe for civil war.
sentences.zh: 而这正是内战的导火索。

sentences.en: I wonder what the point of all of this is then, with Israel saying that it's going to take out Hezbollah.
sentences.zh: 那我就纳闷了，既然以色列说要消灭真主党，这一切的意义到底是什么。

sentences.en: Like, is that kind of the equivalent – this is a super imperfect comparison – but the equivalent of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这就像是——这是一个很不恰当的比较——这是否相当于美国

sentences.en: saying it's going to take out the Taliban,
sentences.zh: 声称要消灭塔利班，

sentences.en: just in terms of one country saying it's going to take out this heavily armed, embedded group in another country that doesn't, for many reasons, seem realistic?
sentences.zh: 仅仅从一个国家宣称要消灭另一个国家境内那个武装精良、根深蒂固的组织的角度来看，由于种种原因，这似乎并不现实？

sentences.en: Like, I just sort of wonder if this is Israel kind of doing what it's always done with Hezbollah,
sentences.zh: 我是说，我只是在想，这是否是以色列在对真主党做它一直以来都在做的事情，

sentences.en: which is basically periodically crippling them, but not actually totally destroying them.
sentences.zh: 也就是定期削弱他们，但实际上并没有彻底摧毁他们。

sentences.en: I mean, that's the rhetoric we've heard, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是我们听到的辞令，对吧？

sentences.en: Is this idea that Israel wants to completely eliminate the threat from Hezbollah.
sentences.zh: 这种想法就是以色列想要彻底消除来自真主党的威胁。

sentences.en: But I think what a lot of people here see is this major buildup of Israeli military forces along the border, on the Israeli side of the border.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这里许多人看到的是，以色列军队在边界沿线、也就是边界的以色列一侧进行了大规模集结。

sentences.en: And that has made people here in Lebanon extremely concerned about the possibility of a massive Israeli ground invasion of southern Lebanon
sentences.zh: 这使得黎巴嫩的民众极其担心以色列对黎巴嫩南部发动大规模地面入侵的可能性，

sentences.en: and possible occupation of a large swath of southern Lebanon, essentially creating a new, much larger buffer zone with Israel.
sentences.zh: 以及可能占领黎巴嫩南部的大片土地，从而实质上与以色列建立一个新的、大得多的缓冲区。

sentences.en: Now, that, of course, has brought up a lot of concerns within Lebanon of mass displacement,
sentences.zh: 当然，这在黎巴嫩国内引发了对大规模流离失所的诸多担忧，

sentences.en: because we've already seen more than a million people displaced from their homes from this conflict.
sentences.zh: 因为我们已经看到这场冲突导致一百多万人流离失所。

sentences.en: And also, this possibility that Israel would reoccupy southern Lebanon just feels like this repeat of history here.
sentences.zh: 此外，以色列重新占领黎巴嫩南部的可能性让人感觉历史正在重演。

sentences.en: And it's coming at a time when these memories of the civil war, of the last occupation, are still seared into people's minds here.
sentences.zh: 而且发生这一幕的时候，人们对内战和上一次占领的记忆仍然深深烙印在脑海中。

sentences.en: And I can imagine for Israel, though, the creation of that buffer zone in southern Lebanon, a buffer zone maybe a.k.a.
sentences.zh: 不过我可以想象，对于以色列来说，在黎巴嫩南部建立这个缓冲区——也就是所谓的占领区——对内塔尼亚胡来说在政治上将是一场胜利，对吧？

sentences.en: occupied territory, would be a win politically for Netanyahu, right?
sentences.zh: 我是说，即便他没有彻底赶走真主党，他最终也可能在黎巴嫩南部获得一块土地，从而至少实现他的一些政治目标。

sentences.en: Like, even if he doesn't oust Hezbollah completely, he may still end up with a swath of land in southern Lebanon that achieves at least some of his political goals.
sentences.zh: 是的，你可以把这视为这种盘算的一部分。

sentences.en: Yeah, you could imagine that as part of this calculation.
sentences.zh: 我们该如何看待美国在这里的角色？

sentences.en: How should we think about the United States' role here?
sentences.zh: 很明显，他们深深卷入了与伊朗的冲突中。

sentences.en: Obviously, they're heavily involved in the conflict with Iran.
sentences.zh: 但他们对以色列在黎巴嫩的行动持什么立场？

sentences.en: But what is their stance on Israel's action in Lebanon?
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，美国

sentences.en: So typically, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 一直试图缓和以色列消灭真主党的努力，因为担心这会演变成一场更大的战争并破坏地区稳定。

sentences.en: has tried to temper Israel's efforts to take out Hezbollah because of these fears of it spiraling into a larger war and destabilizing the region.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么我们以前没有看到以色列卷入这样一场与伊朗的战争的原因。

sentences.en: It's the same reason why we haven't seen Israel involved in a war with Iran like this before.
sentences.zh: 但我们看到这种情况现在开始改变了。

sentences.en: But we're seeing that that's beginning to change now.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 基本上默许了以色列对黎巴嫩展开这种狂轰滥炸。

sentences.en: has essentially allowed Israel to carry out this bombardment of Lebanon.
